why: Five hand-synced registries drifted in 2.x. One table must generate the ids, preset, coverage block and docs, and one factory must cover every class-shaped syntax.
what: New: packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/{rule-table,factory,index}.ts and their tests; index.ts is the single aggregator of rule families. configs/oxlint-plugin.js (2.x) is left alone.
must_not_touch: package.json and bun.lock (v3-deps-w2 / v3-deps-ai added your pins)
contract: docs/v3/concepts/guardrails.md sections 4 (ids), 10 (defineRules sketch), 13, 15. Read docs/v3/spikes/{no-restyle,lint-edges,allow-padding,cn-breakpoints}.md first; where a spike refuted a form, the spike doc wins. The concept names src/lint/table.ts; the index owns rule-table*, so the file is rule-table.ts (flag in PR).
exemplar: configs/oxlint-plugin.js and its test (2.x rule anatomy); guardrails section 10 sketch.
change: defineRules({ id: { family, profiles, zonesOff, defect, forms: [{ id, pattern, fix, next, fixture }] } }) plus classPatternRule(form) over className, cn(), cva(), object-map values, string arrays, [...].join(' ') and template quasis. The table is the one source for: rule ids (ceiling 18), the preset input (consumed by v3-gr-4), the <!-- basalt:coverage --> block with honest 'not guarded:' lines, docs, and the known-id list used to reject unknown waiver ids. index.ts exports the plugin and a FAMILIES list, one import and one entry per line: v3-gr-2, 3a and 3b each add one line there. Messages name the fix token. No real rules here: a synthetic table proves the machinery. Pins: oxlint 1.93.0 and @shadcn/lint 0.2.5 exact, added by v3-deps-w2; v3-sk-3 init writes them into consumers. Rule: none yet. Skill snippet: none (v3-sk-5 tags bullets with ids from this table). Test: rule-table.test.ts, factory.test.ts.
commits: One PR, rebase-merged. Conventional commits, empty scope, no attribution. Package paths only (isolated-basalt-ui); root package.json and bun.lock ride along. Never edit CHANGELOG.md.
proof: RuleTester under oxlint plugins-dev and ESLint.
acceptance: A synthetic form runs green under oxlint's plugins-dev RuleTester and ESLint's
The factory has one invalid case per shape: className, cn(), cva(), object map, array, join, template quasi
The table test fails on a form with no fix text or fixture path, a duplicate id, or more than 18 ids
A generated coverage block contains a 'not guarded:' line for a form marked unguarded
node_modules/.bin/oxlint --version prints 1.93.0 and the root and package pins are exact
out_of_scope: Any real rule or fixture (gr-2, 3a, 3b), the preset (gr-4), the 2.x plugin, ids beyond the 16 planned.
